entry.note: The Fall: the Colony Breach's colony (seed 38, its lift and bores as the owner placed them) with the Surveyor's breakup strung through the middle of the town, bow west along y 150 (gaps 115 and 95): the stern at the town's east edge, the midsection in its middle, the bow and its forge out in the west streets, the drag furrow between; the three holdouts north of the line, one over each section, so every way back to the lock crosses the wreck; no stakes yet
